purpose: Depth stream used on the robot at deployment. Training does not read this file.
source: Depth-stream intrinsics and settings supplied by the robot owner on 2026-11-26 (RealSense D435I, firmware 5.15.1.55, stereo baseline 50.03 mm). They agree with the 848x480 capture in g1_depth_calibration.json after RealSense's resolution scaling (fx 431.943 * 480/848 = 244.496).
mounting_note: No camera-to-torso mounting calibration has been supplied: the capture report's only transform is the factory depth-to-color one. Deployment assumes Hiking's nominal torso mount until a measured mount is given to RealSenseDepthAdapter.
